auth.title: Soo gal
auth.subtitle: Isticmaal lambarka aad wax ku dalbato. Waxaan kuu diraynaa koodh 6-god ah — furaha sirta ah uma baahnid.
auth.phoneHint: Lambarada SO, KE, ET, DJ iyo UG waa la aqbalaa.
auth.magicLinkSent: Fiiri iimaylkaaga — xiriiriye galitaan ayaan u dirnay {email}. Wuxuu dhacayaa 15 daqiiqo gudahood.
auth.staffNote: Shaqaaluhu waa inay ku galaan iimayl ama Google.
auth.whatsappOptIn: WhatsApp iigu soo dir wararka dalabka
auth.whatsappOptInHint: Wararka gaarsiinta iyo rasiidhada. Waad joojin kartaa wakhti kasta.
auth.singleUse: Koodh kasta hal mar ayaa la isticmaali karaa. Cidna ha la wadaagin.
auth.emailHint: Waxaan kuu soo diraynaa xiriiriye hal mar la isticmaalo. Furaha sirta ah uma baahnid.
auth.recoveryEmailHint: Isticmaal iimaylka ku jira akoonkaaga. Haddii uu waafaqo, xiriiriye ayaannu kuu diraynaa.
auth.googleUnavailable: Gelitaanka Google hadda lama heli karo. Isticmaal telefoon ama iimayl.
auth.storyIntro: Akoonkaaga Hurbad. Wax kasta oo aad u baahan tahay, hal meel.
auth.storyTitle: Dalabkaaga, dammaanadaha iyo gaarsiinta — hal meel.
auth.storyBody: Soo gal si aad ula socoto dalabkaaga, u kaydsato rasiidhadaada oo aad caawimo uga hesho dadka yaqaan qalabkaaga.
auth.signupSubtitle: Hal akoon oo dalabkaaga, gaarsiinta iyo dammaanadda ah. Xaqiiji telefoonkaaga si aad u bilowdo.
auth.recoverSubtitle: Ma jiro fure sir ah oo dib loo dejinayo. Dooro hab kale oo lagu xaqiijiyo inaad adiga tahay si aad u gasho.
auth.checkInboxSubtitle: Tallaabadaada xigta waxay ku jirtaa iimaylkaaga.
auth.emailTips: Hubi spam ama promotions haddii iimaylku aanu iman. Xiriiriyuhu hal mar ayuu shaqeeyaa wuxuuna dhacayaa 15 daqiiqo kadib.
auth.verifySubtitle: Geli koodhka aan kuu dirnay. Hal mar ayuu shaqeeyaa wuxuuna dhacayaa 10 daqiiqo kadib.
